thread:
maggie: heads-up — cutting the v1.4.0 SDK release and hitting a regen diff from typegen. also seeing sample-app auth/retry flakiness in CI. blocking the cut.

alex: oh no. is it a real API contract change or just ordering/whitespace?

maggie: typegen-bot posted a diff. looks like OpenAPI property ordering + a small enum rename in responses. sample app tests fail because our auth retry middleware expects 429 shape that changed.

typegen-bot: automated regen diff for packages/typegen at 1808123420: 1 changed file (client.ts). Summary: enum responseStatus: "DEPRECATED" -> "DEPRECATED_V1"; property reorder in ResponseMeta.

sam: can we avoid blocking by doing a patch release and patching sample-app test to accept both shapes? or should we bump minor because enum rename is semver-incompatible?

jen: enum rename sounds breaking. if the OpenAPI upstream changed semantics, we need a minor (or major) bump depending on contract. but if it's just server side adding a new constant we could add aliasing in client.

maggie: agree rename is breaking. but this came from the model-serving API team, they say it's intended. they can roll back if we want, but shipping clients that mismatch is worse.

alex: short-term option: add a compatibility shim in our runtime that maps DEPRECATED_V1 -> DEPRECATED for the retry matcher. quick PR, patch bump, then follow-up proper SDK minor with clean enums.

sam: also seeing CI flake in sample apps: intermittent 401 on first request, then success on retry. logs: ```
[auth-middleware] token fetch failed: transient network error
retrying request...
Received 401 from /v1/embed -> client retries, passes on second attempt
```

maggie: that ties to the retry matcher. if enum shape change breaks the matcher it won't detect 429/401 properly.

ci-bot: buildkite/job/4321 failed: packages/sample-apps › e2e › auth-retry.spec.ts (1 failed)
→ logs: https://ci/build/4321 (private)

alex: plan: 1) small compatibility shim + unit test (patch) 2) regen typegen pinned version update in CI to avoid flapping while teams coordinate 3) publish patch 1.4.1 and un-block release 4) follow up with proper semver-minor 1.5.0 that surfaces enum rename + changelog.

jen: for (2) how do we pin? is it a lockfile change or a code change?

sam: we can pin the codegen/typegen Docker image digest in the CI step and add a required changelog note when bumping. quick patch ensures deterministic regen during releases.

maggie: who can own the patch PR? I can take the shim + tests, alex can handle the CI pin and release notes. sam can coordinate with API team about intended contract.

alex: I'll add a short CI job change: ```yaml
- name: typegen:regen
  image: ghcr.io/redwood/typegen:sha256:abcd1234
  run: pnpm run typegen:regen
```
then add a comment in the release checklist to update the image digest if you want new generator output.

typegen-bot: note: automatic regen should be considered authoritative but reproducible output requires fixed generator version.

maggie: ok i'll open PR 9876 now with the shim + test. patch changelog entry: "compat(auth): map DEPRECATED_V1 to DEPRECATED to maintain retry matching".

sam: tiny ask — can we also add a quick e2e that asserts retry behavior to catch this earlier? maybe run it in the presubmit matrix.

jen: yes add e2e as non-flaky gate. keep it lightweight (one call, simulate transient token fail).

maggie: PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/9876 — includes shim, unit + e2e, and changelog. running CI now.

ci-bot: buildkite/job/4322 started: PR 9876 (maggie)

alex: if CI passes we can cut 1.4.1 and un-block release notes. make sure to add "regen: pinned generator" note.

sam: after release I'll coordinate with API team for a planned minor bump. we should schedule a short deprecation window so consumers are not surprised.

maggie: sounds good. thanks all. :thumbsup:

alex: thanks — if CI flakes again ping me and i'll rerun the job.

ci-bot: buildkite/job/4322 passed.

maggie: released v1.4.1 — patch applied. cutting v1.5.0 next week for the enum rename with full changelog and migration notes.

jen: nice work. documented in the release checklist and added a note in the onboarding guide about regen determinism.

sam: leaving a follow-up ticket to add a typegen version check to the release script so we don't forget. id: TCK-221

maggie: awesome — closing the loop.
